intro.narration: Today is Bunny's birthday! Bunny is so excited and needs your help to get the party ready. Let's go help Bunny!
intro.narration_zh: 今天是小兔子的生日！小兔子好开心，需要你帮忙准备派对。我们一起去帮小兔子吧！

scenes.narration: Bunny wants to make a yummy birthday cake! Can you help find the apple for the cake?
scenes.narration_zh: 小兔子想做一个好吃的生日蛋糕！你能帮忙找到苹果吗？

test.instruction: Which one is the apple? Bunny needs it for the cake!
test.instruction_zh: 哪个是苹果？小兔子做蛋糕需要它！

scenes.feedback_correct: Yay! You found the apple! Now let's make the cake!
scenes.feedback_correct_zh: 太棒了！你找到苹果了！现在我们来做蛋糕吧！
scenes.feedback_incorrect: That's not the apple. The apple is the red fruit! Let's keep going!
scenes.feedback_incorrect_zh: 那不是苹果哦。苹果是那个红色的水果！我们继续吧！

scenes.narration: Bunny is mixing the cake batter! Oh no, Bunny dropped the spoon. Can you find it?
scenes.narration_zh: 小兔子在搅拌蛋糕糊！哎呀，小兔子把勺子弄掉了。你能找到勺子吗？

test.instruction: Touch the spoon so Bunny can stir the cake!
test.instruction_zh: 点一下勺子，这样小兔子就能搅蛋糕了！

scenes.feedback_correct: Great job! Bunny stirs the cake batter. It smells yummy!
scenes.feedback_correct_zh: 做得好！小兔子搅拌蛋糕糊。闻起来好香！
scenes.feedback_incorrect: That's not the spoon. The spoon is for stirring! Let's keep making the cake!
scenes.feedback_incorrect_zh: 那不是勺子哦。勺子是用来搅拌的！我们继续做蛋糕吧！

scenes.narration: The cake is in the oven! Now let's decorate with balloons! Look at all the colorful balloons!
scenes.narration_zh: 蛋糕放进烤箱了！现在我们用气球来装饰吧！看看这些五颜六色的气球！

test.instruction: Can you find the red balloon for Bunny? Tap it!
test.instruction_zh: 你能帮小兔子找到红色气球吗？点一下它！

scenes.feedback_correct: Yay! You found the red balloon! Bunny loves it!
scenes.feedback_correct_zh: 太棒了！你找到红色气球了！小兔子好喜欢！
scenes.feedback_incorrect: That's a nice balloon too! Let's keep decorating!
scenes.feedback_incorrect_zh: 这个气球也很好看！我们继续装饰吧！

fallback.instruction: Can you find a balloon? Touch any balloon!
fallback.instruction_zh: 你能找到气球吗？点一下任何一个气球！

scenes.narration: Ding dong! Someone is at the door! It's Fox! Fox is waving hello!
scenes.narration_zh: 叮咚！有人来了！是小狐狸！小狐狸在招手打招呼！

test.instruction: Fox is saying hello! What should you do?
test.instruction_zh: 小狐狸在打招呼！你应该怎么做？

scenes.feedback_correct: Fox is so happy to see you! You're a great friend!
scenes.feedback_correct_zh: 小狐狸看到你好开心！你真是个好朋友！
scenes.feedback_incorrect: Fox wants to be friends! Let's say hello next time!
scenes.feedback_incorrect_zh: 小狐狸想和你做朋友！下次我们跟它打招呼吧！

scenes.narration: All friends are here! Bunny, Fox, Bear, Panda, Duck, and Cat are sitting at the table. Let's get enough plates for everyone!
scenes.narration_zh: 所有朋友都到了！小兔子、小狐狸、小熊、熊猫、小鸭子和小猫都坐在桌子旁。我们给每个人都准备一个盘子吧！

test.instruction: How many friends are sitting at the table? Count them!
test.instruction_zh: 桌子旁坐了几个朋友？数一数！

scenes.feedback_correct: That's right! There are 6 friends! Let's sing happy birthday!
scenes.feedback_correct_zh: 答对了！有6个朋友！我们来唱生日歌吧！
scenes.feedback_incorrect: Let's count again: Bunny, Fox, Bear, Panda, Duck, Cat — that's 6! Time to sing!
scenes.feedback_incorrect_zh: 我们再数一次：小兔子、小狐狸、小熊、熊猫、小鸭子、小猫 — 一共6个！该唱生日歌了！

scenes.narration: The cake is ready with a candle on top! Let's sing Happy Birthday to Bunny! Can you say it?
scenes.narration_zh: 蛋糕做好了，上面还插着蜡烛！我们一起给小兔子唱生日快乐歌！你能说出来吗？
scenes.feedback_correct: Beautiful! Bunny heard you singing! Bunny is so happy!
scenes.feedback_correct_zh: 唱得真好听！小兔子听到你唱歌了！小兔子好开心！
scenes.feedback_incorrect: That was a great try! Bunny loved hearing your voice!
scenes.feedback_incorrect_zh: 唱得不错！小兔子喜欢听你的声音！

scenes.narration: Now it's time to open presents! Bunny got a big present and a small present. Can you help?
scenes.narration_zh: 现在是拆礼物的时间！小兔子收到了一个大礼物和一个小礼物。你能帮忙吗？
scenes.feedback_correct: Yay! You found the biggest one! I wonder what's inside!
scenes.feedback_correct_zh: 太棒了！你找到最大的了！不知道里面是什么呢！
scenes.feedback_incorrect: That's a present too! Let's see what Bunny got!
scenes.feedback_incorrect_zh: 那也是个礼物！我们看看小兔子收到了什么！

fallback.instruction: Can you touch any present for Bunny?
fallback.instruction_zh: 你能帮小兔子点一个礼物吗？

scenes.narration: What a wonderful party! All the friends had so much fun together. Bunny wants to say thank you!
scenes.narration_zh: 多么棒的派对！所有朋友都玩得好开心。小兔子想说谢谢！

test.instruction: Bunny gave you a special thank-you card! What should you say?
test.instruction_zh: 小兔子给了你一张感谢卡！你应该说什么？

scenes.feedback_correct: You're so polite! Bunny loves you! What a great party!
scenes.feedback_correct_zh: 你真有礼貌！小兔子好喜欢你！多棒的派对啊！
scenes.feedback_incorrect: Bunny still thinks you're great! See you next time!
scenes.feedback_incorrect_zh: 小兔子还是觉得你很棒！下次再见！

fallback.instruction: Bunny is smiling at you! How do you feel?
fallback.instruction_zh: 小兔子在对你笑！你感觉怎么样？

outro.narration: You're such an amazing friend! Bunny had the best birthday ever, all because of you! See you next time!
outro.narration_zh: 你真是太棒了！因为有你，小兔子度过了最棒的生日！下次再见！
